messages.content: When is the best time of year to visit Paris?

expected_facts: best months to visit paris: april, may, june, september
avoid: november, december, january. winter is cold, grey, and rainy with limited outdoor activities.
april to june offers pleasant weather, blooming gardens, and a lively cultural scene. september is warm with smaller crowds and a charming harvest atmosphere.

messages.content: When is the best time of year to visit Dubai?

expected_facts: best months to visit dubai: november, december, january, february, march
avoid: june, july, august, september. summer (june-september) is extremely hot (40c+) and humid, making outdoor activities very uncomfortable.
november through march brings mild temperatures perfect for beaches, desert safaris, and outdoor dining.

messages.content: When is the best time of year to visit Mumbai?

expected_facts: best months to visit mumbai: november, december, january, february
avoid: june, july, august. monsoon season (june-august) brings heavy flooding and major travel disruptions.
november to february offers cool, dry weather ideal for exploring the city, beaches, and the vibrant street food scene.

messages.content: When is the best time of year to visit Hyderabad?

expected_facts: best months to visit hyderabad: october, november, december, january, february
avoid: april, may. april and may are extremely hot (38-42c), making outdoor sightseeing very uncomfortable.
october to february is the most comfortable time to explore historic sites, the old city, and the legendary hyderabadi cuisine.
